Replay vs committed mean S: random 15 inherited-f4 261.96 vs 326.04, fes-then-batched 223.29 vs 277.51, pair table 473.68 vs 473.73; random 21 inherited-f4 2,973.19 vs 4,411.63, fes-then-batched 2,511.41 vs 3,726.09, pair table 1,975.74 vs 1,975.85. Cause: measured word-XOR ratio 0.003776 vs 0.004739 (random 15) and 0.003310 vs 0.004914 (random 21) GAE per XOR. In both runs the GAE rebuilds from the run's own counts at the run's own ratios to <= 3e-16 (committed) and 0 (replay). The ratio fes-then-batched / inherited-f4 moved from 0.8512 to 0.8524 (random 15) and 0.8446 to 0.8447 (random 21). These README numbers therefore recompute from the committed data but are not reproducible quantities; the count-based band is.
Wall-clock leaves (not part of S), the markdown rendering and the binary hash, as expected.
